Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/jbig2dec && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"jbig2_halftone.c","function":"jbig2_decode_gray_scale_image","line":312,"var":"consumed_bytes","code":"code = jbig2_decode_halftone_mmr(ctx, &rparams, data, size, GSPLANES[GSBPP - 1], &consumed_bytes);","note":"The first MMR bitplane decode starts with consumed_bytes at 0 and passes it by reference for later reuse."},
  {"step":2,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_halftone_mmr","line":1147,"var":"*consumed_bytes","code":"*consumed_bytes += mmr.data_index + (mmr.bit_index >> 3) + (mmr.bit_index > 0 ? 1 : 0);","note":"The decoder reports bytes consumed from its internal cursor, including buffered bits that were not actually read from the current input slice."},
  {"step":3,"file":"jbig2_halftone.c","function":"jbig2_decode_gray_scale_image","line":340,"var":"data + consumed_bytes, size - consumed_bytes","code":"code = jbig2_decode_halftone_mmr(ctx, &rparams, data + consumed_bytes, size - consumed_bytes, GSPLANES[j], &consumed_bytes);","note":"The caller reuses the reported count to advance the input pointer and subtract from the remaining size for the next plane."},
  {"step":4,"file":"jbig2_halftone.c","function":"jbig2_decode_gray_scale_image","line":340,"var":"size - consumed_bytes","code":"code = jbig2_decode_halftone_mmr(ctx, &rparams, data + consumed_bytes, size - consumed_bytes, GSPLANES[j], &consumed_bytes);","note":"Because consumed_bytes can be larger than the true bytes read, the subtraction underflows and produces an oversized remaining length."},
  {"step":5,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_consume","line":67,"var":"mmr->data_index + 4 < mmr->size","code":"if (mmr->data_index + 4 < mmr->size) mmr->word |= (mmr->data[mmr->data_index + 4] << mmr->bit_index);","note":"With the underflowed length, subsequent MMR decoding operates on the wrong slice and can index beyond the intended encoded buffer while refilling the word buffer."},
  {"step":6,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_line","line":857,"var":"mmr->word","code":"uint32_t word = mmr->word;","note":"The corrupted cursor state drives later code selection and eventually triggers an out-of-bounds read from the MMR input stream."}
]
p.write_text(json.dumps(trace, separators=(',',':')))
print(p)
PY
